scientific_integrity: Proof by exact derivative quartic, Descartes sign changes, positive/negative interval transforms, resultant elimination, and implicit-function edge expansion; independent algebraic and high-precision checks accompany the text. The input coefficient and spinodal are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem optimizes an existing macroscopic-fluctuation-theory asymptotic coefficient for uniform, zero-magnetization quenched profiles in the linearly stable 0<=Pe<4 regime, not finite-size microscopic current variance or the unstable phase. Near criticality convergence may be nonuniform; independent scientific validation and definitive publication-priority verification have not been performed.
title: A reentrant optimal-density law for current fluctuations in an interacting active lattice gas
